oneOf.title: Access Key
oneOf.description: Authenticate with the access key of an IAM user, or with temporary credentials (access key, secret access key and session token) issued by AWS STS.

access_key_id.description: The access key ID. Airbyte needs the dynamodb:ListTables, dynamodb:DescribeTable and dynamodb:Scan permissions on the tables to replicate.
access_key_id.title: Access Key ID

secret_access_key.description: The secret access key that corresponds to the access key ID.
secret_access_key.title: Secret Access Key

session_token.description: The session token of temporary credentials issued by AWS STS. Leave empty when using the long-lived access key of an IAM user.
session_token.title: Session Token

oneOf.title: Access Key and IAM Role
oneOf.description: Authenticate with an access key that may assume an IAM role (sts:AssumeRole), then read DynamoDB with the role's temporary credentials. Use this for cross-account access.

access_key_id.description: The access key ID of the IAM identity that is allowed to assume the role (sts:AssumeRole).
access_key_id.title: Access Key ID

secret_access_key.description: The secret access key that corresponds to the access key ID.
secret_access_key.title: Secret Access Key

session_token.description: The session token, only when the access key above is itself a temporary credential issued by AWS STS.
session_token.title: Session Token

role_arn.description: The ARN of the IAM role to assume. The role needs the dynamodb:ListTables, dynamodb:DescribeTable and dynamodb:Scan permissions on the tables to replicate, and its trust policy must allow the access key's identity to assume it.
role_arn.title: Role ARN

external_id.description: The external ID that the role's trust policy requires (sts:ExternalId condition), if any.
external_id.title: External ID

credentials.description: How the connector authenticates with AWS. Credentials are read from this configuration only; the connector cannot use AWS profiles, instance roles or environment variables.
credentials.title: Credentials

region.description: The AWS region of the DynamoDB tables.
region.title: AWS Region

endpoint.description: Optional endpoint override, for example a VPC endpoint, a FIPS endpoint or a DynamoDB Local instance. Leave empty to use the public endpoint of the region.
endpoint.title: DynamoDB Endpoint

reserved_attribute_names.description: Comma separated names of attributes that are DynamoDB reserved words or contain special characters. No longer needed: every attribute is now aliased in scan expressions; kept for backward compatibility.
reserved_attribute_names.title: Reserved attribute names

ignore_missing_read_permissions_tables.description: Ignore tables with missing scan/read permissions
ignore_missing_read_permissions_tables.title: Ignore missing read permissions tables

discover_sample_size.description: The maximum number of items to scan per table when discovering its attributes and their types. A larger sample finds rarer attributes but consumes more read capacity. Defaults to 1000.
discover_sample_size.title: Discovery sample size (Advanced)

checkpoint_target_interval_seconds.description: How often (in seconds) a stream should checkpoint its progress, when possible. A table is scanned in rounds of about this duration and its state is saved after each round, so that an interrupted sync resumes where it stopped. Defaults to 300.
checkpoint_target_interval_seconds.title: Checkpoint Target Time Interval (Advanced)
